question: Analyze the past performance of all the asset types, stock, commodity, real estate, forex and propose which type of asset is worth to invest in based on investors' risk apetite
query: SELECT     sstock_index,     AVG(close_price) AS avg_close_price,     STDDEV(close_price) AS stddev_close_price,     AVG(daily_high) AS avg_daily_high,     AVG(daily_low) AS avg_daily_low,     AVG(trading_volume) AS avg_trading_volume,     AVG(consumer_confidence_index) AS avg_consumer_confidence,     AVG(inflation_rate) AS avg_inflation_rate,     AVG(interest_rate) AS avg_interest_rate,     AVG(gold_price) AS avg_gold_price,     AVG(crude_oil_price) AS avg_crude_oil_price,     AVG(forex_usd_eur) AS avg_forex_usd_eur,     AVG(forex_usd_jpy) AS avg_forex_usd_jpy,     AVG(real_estate_index) AS avg_real_estate_index,     AVG(retail_sales) AS avg_retail_sales,     AVG(venture_capital_funding) AS avg_venture_capital_funding,     AVG(consumer_spending) AS avg_consumer_spending FROM     finance_economics_dataset WHERE     sstock_index IN ('SPY', 'DJI', 'NASDAQ') GROUP BY     sstock_index ORDER BY     avg_close_price DESC;
